Problem Summary:
Support encoding and decoding session SQL bindings.

### What is changed and how it works?

- Register `SessionHandle` to `session.sessionStateHandlers` to handle SQL bindings.
- Add `EncodeSessionStates` and `DecodeSessionStates` to `SessionHandle`.

issue_context.title: support encoding SQL bindings for session manager
issue_context.body:
The session manager needs to get all the states for the current session through `show session_states` and restore them on the other session through `set session_states ...`.
This includes session-scoped SQL bindings.

review_comments: Could you explain why using `hack.String` here and `hack.Slice` when decoding?
`sessionStates.Bindings` is defined as `string` instead of `[]bytes` to be readable. `hack.String` and `hack.Slice` convert between `[]byte` and `string` without copy.
So it is not required actually, just for performance consideration. Thanks.
Please add some comments on the serialized json value "-"
I removed this because I found it's duplicate: `CreateSessionWithOpt` has already called `createSessionWithOpt` to initialize `sessionHandle`.
